review.tagline: Status line plugin for Claude Code showing context, usage limits and todos
review.summary: Claude HUD is a Claude Code plugin that registers a status line command, which prints context-window usage, subscriber rate limits, model, project path and git branch below the input. Optional lines show active tools, subagents, skills, MCP servers and todo progress, read from the session transcript. Settings live in a JSON config file or the /claude-hud:configure flow, and it needs no tmux or separate window.
review.audience: Claude Code users who want live context and rate-limit visibility
strengths: Installs from the Claude Code plugin marketplace with a few slash commands
Reads session data Claude Code passes on stdin; no separate window or tmux
Extensive config: layout, element order, thresholds, colors, git and jj status
Labels available in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese
weaknesses: Subscriber usage limits are hidden on API-key, Bedrock and Vertex sessions
Tools, agents and todos lines are off by default and parse the transcript
Needs a JavaScript runtime; Windows users must install Node.js separately
